verdict.rationale: A hosted public trust center is a fair question for a compliance automation platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a public trust page, click-through NDA gating, or externally shared live control status. The live dashboards, audit-ready reports and vendor security questionnaires shown in the evidence are internal or inbound vendor-risk features, which are adjacent to this story and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I get a hosted public trust center — live control status, certifications, and reports shared under click-through NDA — that closes security reviews before they start
